status: recon complete; campaign tracked in public issue HangGlidersRule/model-forge#18
policy: Quantize from the upstream BF16 weights only. Third-party quantized checkpoints are evidence only, never build inputs. No abliteration (an embedding model has no refusal behavior).

license.declared_in: LICENSE file in the upstream repository
license.redistribution: Modified weights may be redistributed. Ship the Apache-2.0 text and mark modified files.

files.lm_head: absent: the checkpoint is the decoder only; embeddings are the last-token hidden state

architecture.kind: dense Qwen3 decoder used as a text embedder (last-token pooling, L2-normalized)
architecture.matryoshka: truncation to smaller dimensions supported (renormalize after truncation)

decoder_linear_work_share.source: parameter counts of the decoder linears (6.95B), computed from the export headers
